text: Offer small, varied meals and do not force him to finish the amount; picky eating is a phase that will pass.

review_defects.english: do not force him to finish the amount
review_defects.why: The Arabic literally says 'do not force him on the quantity' without the verb 'finish'. The English adds 'to finish', which may imply forcing the child to consume everything served, while the Arabic is more general about not forcing a specific quantity.
